result: Kernel-checked, with 0 sorry and only the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, in 339 declarations across five non-default targets: (1) BornGaussianParallelogramRigidity (header corrected: poles e2, e2 + e3, e2 + i e3 of squared norms 1, 2, 2; single signed export); (2) GleasonRealSphere; (3) GleasonComplexSphere; (4) GleasonGaussianBridge: born_of_uniformlyRayContinuous; (5) GleasonBornCompletion: born_density_matrix_of_uniformlyRayContinuous (unique positive semidefinite trace-one complex matrix representing the extension F f of a nonnegative, uniformly ray-continuous frame function on all of C^3 minus 0 and f itself on Q(i)^3 minus 0), eq_of_re_dotC_mulVec_self (Hermitian 3 x 3 matrices are determined by their real quadratic form away from 0), isUniformlyRayContinuous_quadRay (every rational Hermitian Rayleigh quotient is uniformly continuous on rays) and uniformlyRayContinuous_frameFunction_iff (uniformly ray-continuous frame functions on Q(i)^3 are exactly the trace-one rational Hermitian Rayleigh quotients).
proof_boundary: The results are conditional on the declared input IsUniformlyRayContinuous f (uniform continuity on rays in the squared ray distance raySinSq u v = 1 - |<u,v>|^2/(<u,u><v,v>), whose square root is the ray metric), a mathematical input that requires justification and is not derived here; recorded as DAG nodes FQ-GLEASON-QI3-UNIFORM-RAY-CONTINUITY (TFQ-1056, CONDITIONAL) and FQ-BORN-QI3-CONTINUUM-COMPLETION (TFQ-1060, CONDITIONAL). Whether pointwise Archimedean continuity at every nonzero vector implies it for frame functions is FQ-GLEASON-QI3-POINTWISE-TO-UNIFORM (TFQ-1057, OPEN); signed and nonnegative versions are distinguished there. FQ-GLEASON-QI3-FRAME-FUNCTIONS (TFQ-1055) asks about unrestricted frame functions and its unrestricted rigidity assertion is REFUTED by the exotic Q(i)^3 frame function; nothing here changes that. FQ-GAP-BORN-UNIQUENESS-GLEASON (TFQ-0307) stays CONDITIONAL. The hypothesis class is not empty: isUniformlyRayContinuous_quadRay shows that the Rayleigh quotient of every rational Hermitian form is uniformly continuous on rays, with an existential modulus from compactness of the unit sphere of C^3 (no quantitative delta is computed). Rational-valued data determine Gaussian-rational coefficients only; arbitrary complex density matrices are not covered.
